description: ARM assembly source code implementing cryptographic functions for Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) operations, including initialization, multiplication, and hashing, optimized with NEON instructions.

methods.name: gcm_init_neon
methods.description: Initializes NEON registers for GCM with the hash subkey.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_neon
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication using NEON instructions.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_neon
methods.description: Computes GHASH over input data using NEON instructions.
